physical_coverage.geometry: two-leg open spinful Hubbard ladder, 96 rungs, 192 physical sites
physical_coverage.hamiltonian: H = -sum_<ij>,sigma (cdag_i,sigma c_j,sigma + h.c.) + 8 sum_i n_i,up n_i,down; uniform leg/rung hopping 1
contract_reasons: Spinful fermion Hubbard is not one of spin1_chain, spinhalf_ladder, bose_hubbard.
No separate sectors supply required gaps.

output_xml.interpretation: Incomplete author output XML; not repaired.

last_sweep_energy_array_audit.warning: Stored zeros prevent using the terminal-array delta as a convergence test. Cause not established; no data repaired. Final results/Energy remains separately reported.

checkpoint_audit.other_examples: domain_wall and z2_example contain scripts/models, no additional HDF5 outputs or states.

method.alignment: Every correlation vector sorted by parsed coordinate tuple before channel sums or cross-chi comparisons; necessary for chi3600 pair field 4.
method.pair_combination: pair field 1 - pair field 2 - pair field 3 + pair field 4, no prefactor
method.center_averaging: Exact distributed script: shifts -5..5 (11 values), distances 1..84, left rung int(48-distance/2+shift). Paper caption says 10 pairs; script is authoritative for this audit.
method.connected_charge: Sum four spin-resolved density correlations minus (nup_i+ndown_i)*(nup_j+ndown_j).
method.differences: Absolute/rms/norm-relative comparisons of existing finite-chi results; not error bounds or exact references.

limits: Seven chi settings are seven numerical approximations to one Hamiltonian and one sector, not independent physical cases.
No checkpoint tensors exist in the archive or in HDF5 groups; author chkpfile paths are stale external path strings.
Energy variance remains nonzero and final-chi correlation differences are nonzero. No claim of rigorous convergence or exact ground truth.
Extra neff exists only at chi3600; defining operator not established from included source, so it is not interpreted or scored.
Output XML task1 is incomplete; XML and HDF5 values/settings differ. They cannot be mixed as interchangeable numerical results.
Selecting new rows, windows, query positions, density channels or chi values does not vary physics.
Gauge/site relabelings, trivial energy shifts/scalings and equivalent transformations are not fresh physical heldouts.
Hubbard-to-spin/Bose substitutions would not exactly preserve the finite doped Hamiltonian and would breach the frozen family contract.
Cropping correlations to a smaller subsystem does not provide its isolated ground-state energy/state.
Fresh changes to physical size, couplings, fields or sector need new validated calculations; none are supplied or assumed here.

Chi3200 iteration15 energy has 282 exact zeros, including its tail. Its raw last_sweep_terminal_energy_change is invalid as a convergence diagnostic; use the explicit array audit and do not infer sweep convergence.
conclusion: No-go for an archive-backed fresh within-concept ratchet. Useful historical convergence evidence only; does not overturn the reported successful original/stress c03 scores. This is not a claim that every conceivable within-bound instance has been tested.
